22.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="32" x="0" y="32">the number of columns in the first matrix</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="32" x="0" y="74.24">(A) must be equal to the number of rows in</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="32" x="0" y="116.48">the second matrix (B)</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="32" x="0" y="158.72">A: m × n</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="32" x="0" y="200.96">B: n × p</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="32" x="0" y="243.2">C: m × p</text></g>

9.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="0" y="0" width="466" height="238" rx="3" fill="#f0eee6" stroke="#dedbd2" stroke-width="1"/></g>

19.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="30" x="0" y="30">Each entry of C = AB is a dot</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="30" x="0" y="69.6">product:</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="30" x="0" y="109.2">c_ij = (row i of A) · (col j of B)</text></g>

18.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text fill="#141413" font-family="Consolas,Consolas_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="31" x="0" y="31">A : [1 2]</text><text fill="#141413" font-family="Consolas,Consolas_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="31" x="0" y="71.92">B : [5; 7]</text><text fill="#141413" font-family="Consolas,Consolas_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="31" x="0" y="112.84">C = 1·5 + 2·7 = 19</text><text fill="#141413" font-family="Consolas,Consolas_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" font-size="31" x="0" y="153.76">shop 2: 3·5 + 4·7 = 43</text></g>

5.svg: <g xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="34" x="0" y="34">Each column of C is A times the matching column of B, so it is a linear</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="34" x="0" y="78.88">combination of the columns of A.</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="34" x="0" y="123.76">Each row of C is the matching row of A times B, a linear combination of</text><text font-family="Inter,Inter_MSFontService,sans-serif" font-weight="400" fill="#141413" font-size="34" x="0" y="168.64">the rows of B.</text></g>
